name: Lose the Heat 2
storyline: Set across a single night in a semi-open city, Lose the Heat 2 follows the protagonist after his girlfriend is kidnapped by an unknown extortionist. Forced to follow the kidnapper's text messages and complete six high-stakes delivery and extraction missions before dawn, players must evade an escalating police force, including aggressive pursuit cruisers, undercover units, and police motorcyclists who leap onto the player's windshield, while triggering explosive environmental traps to survive.
summary: Lose the Heat 2 is a 3D arcade driving and police pursuit browser game. Built on the Adobe Shockwave engine, it is the direct sequel to Lose the Heat, shifting the series from daytime contract driving to a single-night hostage rescue thriller.
